capabilities: Render ssh code blocks as clickable terminals in Reading View and Live Preview
Connect using inline host, username, and password fields in Markdown
Connect through saved profiles with passwords encrypted via Electron safeStorage
Keep sessions alive across document switches and reopen Terminal tabs without disconnecting
Confirm host keys on first connection and block later mismatches
extras: Desktop Obsidian only; password authentication only (no SFTP, port forwarding, jump hosts, private keys, SSH Agent, or mobile). Warns that inline passwords are stored as plaintext in Markdown and may leak via sync, backup, or Git. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian code blocks are static, so a note cannot hold a live, clickable SSH session for runbooks, lab guides, or operations work.
summary: SSH terminal plugin that renders ssh code blocks as interactive terminals in Reading View and Live Preview, using inline credentials or saved profiles.
